notes.title: Voxella Epsilon-6
notes.content:
EPSILON-6: 2/18/2024
fixed everything!
-added paintbrushes and brick walls!
-changed weather and added clear skies
-changed knockback; it doesn't bounce you into the air anymore.
-fixed bugs with sugarloaves, mushroomcaps, houses, and beaches
-added some more splash text
-washing machines are now no longer the single worst programmed thing in this game

notes.title: Voxella Epsilon-5
notes.content:
EPSILON-5: 2/13/2024
"random stuff" update as if that isn't literally every update
-the player is slightly slippery
-updated the CLOUDS and the credits
-translated untranslated texts in toki pona
-fixed bugs with rainbowpass, scarecrow and late doppler

notes.title: Voxella Epsilon-4
notes.content:
EPSILON-4: 1/21/2024
this update has a variable named "housey" which is just kinda funny:
-added 5 new commands: help, light, fog, toggleconsoles, and adventure
-changed the room command, the new format is "room <x>,<y> <biome>"
-there is a file called commands.txt which should help in understanding the different commands
-you can now copy and paste into the command prompt
-you now respawn at your house, or the last house you went into if you have many. (houses are also cheaper now)
-stellaria has cooler lighting
-fixed a bug where sounds would still play after exiting to the menu, which has honestly been in this game for far too long

notes.title: Voxella Epsilon-3
notes.content:
EPSILON-3: 1/5/2024
-an arrow now points to where you are aiming
-fixed a crash while talking to kwaiiat
-lighting effects should be less laggy

notes.title: Voxella Epsilon-2
notes.content:
EPSILON-2: 12/27/2023
-added the magic 8 ball
-you can no longer pick up items after death :)
-glue is cheaper, cutty now sells playing cards
-reduced lag on lighting effects
-added some general additions
-fixed minor bug relating to npc sound effects

notes.title: Voxella Epsilon-1
notes.content:
EPSILON-1: 11/19/2023
the end is nigh:
-added a new biome, stellaria!
-enemy ai has been massively improved
-added 2 new enemies, antimony and bluey
-introduced the sphinx of black quartz, sorbit, the blacksmith, ilham, jadav, and the scarecrow
-npcs and allied enemies have some more extra special dialogue :0
-new weapons & accessories: kunai, curling stones, pentacles, ice swords, double edged swords, lunar wands, dark staffs, clubs, shoelaces, blindfold, sleep masks, leftovers, 10 gallon hats, groucho glasses, repellants, and swazzles.
-added a new armor set, allium armor! there is also a sword and an accessory to go with it.
-other new items: alliums, stellar flowers, bouquets, defibrillators, counters, angel statues, pressure plates, stonecutters, bubblegum elixirs, compost bins and compost, beach towels, mycelium, sugarloaves, kilns, incense burners, drink mix, mailboxes, and colored flower pots.
-ice golem statues are now obtainable
-added 6 new debuffs: reperfusion, invincibility, satiation, weakness, slowdown, and phasing
-potions now require 3 materials to craft again
-balanced a ton of stuff; armor is more effective and magic weapons are actually usable
-changed the way that boss spawns work: they now respawn in the second room of the dungeon, instead of the room where you first find them.
-fixed fences not fencing things
-enemy spawners in rainbowpass can now be destroyed
-changed the floor
-added 4 new commands, cleardebuff, sweep, character and difficulty
-changed the way saves work: they should now no longer break in future updates!
-added new splashes
-fixed insects

notes.title: Voxella Delta-17
notes.content:
DELTA-17: 1/14/2023
-removed the restart and worldgen commands, and added the reload command.
-fixed a crash in the microfactory

notes.title: Voxella Delta-16
notes.content:
DELTA-16: 12/23/2022
some tweaks, changes, alterations, and fixings of the buggy variety:
-added return stars. relatedly, you can no longer get softlocked in card castle
-glass flowers and ice lilies can now be collected! with scissors
-added a bit more special dialogue
-added sound effects for making potions, getting water, being shocked, combining accessories, and infusing armor.
-there is a new command, text
-console commands and sapling growth timers now save!
-you can no longer kill bosses multiple times
-fixed various bugs
-added more splashes

notes.title: Voxella Delta-15
notes.content:
DELTA-15: 12/18/2022
-it's the winter season! npcs have new festive dialogue, emery has christmas trees for sale, and santa has come to the city!
-added an option to disable intensive lighting effects
-fixed bugs with the sky and glass garden

notes.title: Voxella Delta-14
notes.content:
DELTA-14: 12/17/2022
-added an option to disable wind
-did some optimizations to my code, particularly the graphics
-not literally the ENTIRE soundtrack is stored in memory; the game should take up much less ram

notes.title: Voxella Delta-13
notes.content:
DELTA-13: 12/11/2022
the fishing update, part 2:
-added fishing hats, backpacks, cascabels, decorated ribbons, and century standards
-castoro has a new quest!
-fixed a bug where using allied mimics while sliding on ice would create invisible chests

notes.title: Voxella Delta-12
notes.content:
DELTA-12: 12/1/2022
hardcore gaming:
-added expert mode! in this mode, enemies have more health and do double damage, bosses regenerate life, and debuffs last twice as long.
-added a new character, tayna, who cannot regenerate health.
-seigen now dies permanently
-shield cooldown is slightly faster
-fixed some bugs with object collision and transparency, as well as a crash when the game is minimized

notes.title: Voxella Delta-11
notes.content:
DELTA-11: 11/27/2022
some new developments:
-added 6 new debuffs: invisibility, extra health, fighting II, hunting, fishing, and exhaustion
-there is now a second floor to the business center, where you can find cutty!
-dr greaves now sells vanilla and matcha elixirs.
-kelp is no longer mysterious
-cheese now costs more due to inflation

notes.title: Voxella Delta-10
notes.content:
DELTA-10: 11/20/2022
the next update is finally dophinished! please do let minnow what you think of this one:
-added fishing nets! and also salmon, tuna, rockfish, cod, kelp, and blue fish scales
-added an interface to remap buttons in-game!!
-enemies no longer spawn in the cafe
-paper is now letterwise instead of A4
-translated untraslated texts in toki pona
-fixed a bug where phantom npcs would appear in corners of rooms

notes.title: Voxella Delta-9
notes.content:
DELTA-9: 11/5/2022
enemy newtext, part 4:
-allied enemies have more dialogue!
-added the kotatsu, lamp, and jukebox
-opening an umbrella indoors gives you bad luck
-fixed a bug where muigi would turn into a tree

notes.title: Voxella Delta-8
notes.content:
DELTA-8: 10/31/2022
happy halloween!!! here's a totally unrelated update:
-added the cafe, a special area of the factory! the chef and server now reside there.
-added speed potions and the speed II buff
-junmberlack and miner now give less coins
-there are now more buttons on the menu! added an exit button and a discord link button
-tool's tooltips are fixed.
-did some general polish and bug fixing

notes.title: Voxella Delta-7
notes.content:
DELTA-7: 10/30/2022
some new things:
-added a new npc, castoro!
-added shields, matcha, and slowness potions
-buffed various dungeon enemies, all enemies have larger aggro range again
-potions now only take 1 material instead of 3
-regular potions can no longer be crafted and are rarer.
-the baton is now actually obtainable
